t Nopeind
is a hamlet in the
Dutch
province of
North Holland
. It is a part of the municipality of
Amsterdam
, and lies about 7 km northeast of the city centre, just north of
Zunderdorp
.
't Nopeind is a part of the
deelgemeente
(sub-municipality)
Amsterdam-Noord
. The hamlet has about 35 inhabitants.
